ns2:section.sectionText: Title: US Foreign Relations, WWI-9/11 Topic: U.S. foreign relations in the American century, stretching from World War I through the terrorist attacks of 9/11/2001. Topics include the U.S. rise to superpower status, total war, limited war, development, human rights, globalization, non-state actors, the interplay between world affairs and American democracy, and the limits of U.S. power in the face of anticolonial nationalism, great power rivalries, and terrorist attacks.
